label: Higgsfield Product Photo
description: Higgsfield product photoshoot and marketplace-card workflow. Generates professional product imagery with controlled environment and lighting.

product_image.label: Product Image
product_image.description: Source image of the product to be placed in the generated scene.

scene_prompt.label: Scene Description
scene_prompt.description: Environment, surface, and atmosphere for the product shoot.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: Write product shoot scene descriptions for Higgsfield. The scene_prompt should describe the environment and mood, not the product itself — Higgsfield composites the product from the product_image. Focus on surface texture, material context, ambient atmosphere, and any lifestyle elements. Think: where would this product live in a real shoot?

field_guides.product_image: Local path to the product source image. Must be a clean photo of the product, ideally against a plain background.
field_guides.scene_prompt: The set: surface material, environment, ambient mood. Do not describe the product — it will be placed automatically. Example: 'Marble bathroom counter, morning steam, blurred greenery in background.'
field_guides.lighting: Match to brand aesthetic and product category: studio_soft for clean DTC; natural_window for beauty/wellness; golden_hour for lifestyle; dramatic_contrast for luxury.
field_guides.background: clean_white for Amazon/marketplace listings; lifestyle_scene for social/editorial; textured_surface for artisan/premium.

output.scene_prompt: White marble counter with small water drops, soft morning light, blurred bathroom mirror in background, scattered dried flower petals.

do: Describe the scene environment, not the product
Match lighting to the brand's target aesthetic
Use 1:1 for marketplace listings, 4:5 or 9:16 for social
dont: Write the product name or appearance in scene_prompt — it is placed via product_image
